title: Imp Jar Select Cherry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Imp Jar Select Cherry offers a fruity vape with a refreshing twist. The flavour of sweet and tangy Red Cherries is perfectly blended with a cool, icy Menthol taste that becomes noticeable on the exhale, balancing the rich fruit notes. The Imp Jar Select nic salt range utilise twice as much flavour concentrate as standard e-liquids for an intense flavour payoff which pairs perfectly with starter kits and refillable pod kits. Launched in conjunction with Imp Jar's first pod vape kit, the Imp Jar Select, Imp Jar Select Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
